Comments.KeyProvider: Set to 'Manual' to use keys from appsettings
Comments.PrimaryKeyId: The ID of the key to use for new encryptions
Comments.Id: Unique identifier for each key (used for key rotation)
Comments.CreatedUtc: Optional timestamp when the key was created
Comments.SECURITY_WARNING: NEVER commit real encryption keys to source control! Use environment variables or Azure App Configuration for production. Generate keys with: openssl rand -base64 32
